summary: The trend is healthy (SPY 6.03% above its 200-day, 20-day realized vol 10.1%), but leadership is split: defensives and energy lead 21-day returns while Nasdaq and Communication fall. Appetite should stay normal, not stretched; prefer US core equity and broad participation over international, EM or crypto.
reasons: Volatility is easing: VIXY 5d -5.88% and 63d -18.77%, with no fear spike.
Breadth is good: equal-weight RSP 21d +5.78% beats SPY +0.88%, and IWM 5d +2.65% (21d +2.20%), though IWM 63d is still -2.21%.
Growth is the weak spot: QQQ 21d -3.30% (5d +1.54%), XLK 21d -3.58% (5d +3.51%), XLC 5d -5.78%, 21d -8.80%, 10% below its 200-day. This is why the stance is not risk-on.
Defensive and cyclical-value leadership over 21d: XLE +11.72%, XLP +9.40%, XLU +9.38%, XLV +9.27%. Defensives leading while tech lags is a mixed risk signal, even though XLP 5d is -2.01%.
Rates are mixed: TLT 21d +5.19% (long yields down over the month) but 5d -0.31%; IEF 21d +2.53%, still 1.38% under its 200-day. Bond trend is a bounce, not yet a confirmed uptrend.
Credit is steady: HYG 5d +0.62%, 21d +0.92%, 0.40% under its 200-day; LQD 21d +2.44%. No stress signal.
Gold is weak: GLD 21d -3.22%, 10.82% below its 200-day. Dollar is firm: UUP 63d +3.09%, 4.02% above its 200-day, a mild headwind for international and EM.

asset_class_view.equity_etfs: Prefer US core. VOO 21d +0.92%, 63d +3.27%, 6.07% above its 200-day; VTI similar. VXUS 21d -1.54%, 63d -0.94% and VWO 21d -4.57%, 63d -3.48%, below its 200-day (-2.76%) look unattractive with the dollar firm. QQQ 21d -3.30% is lagging, so tilt away from concentrated growth. VNQ 21d +4.73% is bouncing but 63d -4.31%.
asset_class_view.bonds_gold: Bonds are rallying on a one-month view (BND 21d +2.12%, IEF +2.53%, TLT +5.19%) but remain below their 200-day averages, so they are a modest ballast rather than a strong buy. Gold looks risky: GLD 10.82% below its 200-day, 21d -3.22%, vol 28.6%.
asset_class_view.crypto: Risky. BTC 21d -4.76%, 63d -3.07%, vol 44.2%; ETH 21d -9.03%, 63d -10.47%, vol 60.9%. BTC is 6.43% above its 200-day but the trend is fading; ETH is worse. Keep sizing small if at all.

watch: SPY closing below its 200-day (725.62) would turn the regime filter off and move this to risk-off.
QQQ and XLK failing to recover (QQQ 21d is -3.30%) or XLC extending lower would push toward risk-off; a QQQ 21d turn positive with RSP holding would move toward risk-on.
VIXY reversing its decline (5d currently -5.88%) or HYG dropping further below its 200-day (-0.40%) would signal rising stress.
TLT breaking lower while UUP climbs (UUP 63d +3.09%) would mean tighter conditions and hurt both bonds and equities.
